newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 3.
newsitem.headline: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 3.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
The Equitable Life Assurance Society ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Fraser Range Granite NL on 24/03/1997.
Mercury Asset Management plc ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Forrestania Gold NL on 27/03/1997.
PDFM Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Goodman Fielder Limited on 20/03/1997, from 181,589,367 ordinary shares (14.8%) to 173,209,280 ordinary shares (13.952%).
Mercury Asset Management plc increased its relevant interest in Capricorn Resources Australia NL on 27/03/1997, from 4,000,000 ordinary shares (5.98%) to 5,260,000 ordinary shares (7.87%).
PDFM Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Goodman Fielder Limited on 20/03/1997, from 181,589,367 ordinary shares (14.8%) to 173,209,280 ordinary shares (13.952%).
LionOre Mining International Ltd increased its relevant interest in Forrestania Gold NL on 25/03/1997, from 47,761,687 ordinary shares (79.13%) to 48,698,171 ordinary shares (80.68%).
Noble Investments Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Bisan Limited on 02/04/1997, from 1,321,000 ordinary shares (8.006%) to 1,544,000 ordinary shares (9.36%)

Helen M Schutt Nominees Ltd, Darwell Martin Hutchinson and John Barry ceased to be a substantial Hutchinson all of 8th Floor, 20 Queen Street, Melbourne shareholder in MBL Holdings Limited on 21/02/1997.
GLS International Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Finbar International Limited on 24/03/1997.

Baguio International Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Finbar International Limited on 24/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 2,961,312 ordinary shares (6.66%).
Belmont Holdings Limited ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Gearhart Australia Limited on 01/04/1997.

The Board of Belmont Holdings Limited advises that it has sold its 5.1% shareholding in Gearhart Australia Limited. It also announces that Mr V J Plummer has stood down as a Director of group companies.
DC International Ltd increased its relevant interest in Dc International Limited on 16/09/1996, from 30,324,167 ordinary shares (61.24%) to 67,292,615 ordinary shares (59.38%).
Churchill Resources NL increased its relevant interest in Union Gold Mining Company Nl (The) on 21/03/1997, from 47,017,693 ordinary shares (47.77%) to 47,074,225 ordinary shares (47.83%).
SAS Trustee Corporation became a substantial shareholder in Ge Crane Holdings Limited on 27/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 1,889,906 ordinary shares (5.02%).
Cadenza Securities Trading International Ltd decreased its relevant interest in J Boag & Son Limited on 30/03/1997, from 20,314,550 ordinary shares (32.5%) to 19,314,550 ordinary shares (30.9%).
Cadenza Securities Trading International Ltd decreased its relevant interest in J Boag & Son Limited on 20/03/1997, from 20,656,050 ordinary shares (34.00%) to 19,314,500 ordinary shares (30.9%).

Downer Group Australia Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Century Drilling Limited on 01/04/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 11,411,889 ordinary shares (20.91%).
AMP Society became a substantial shareholder in Capral Aluminium Limited on 27/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 9,900,767 ordinary shares (5.35%).
